backup.production_rule: s115 (Lloyd 2026-11-11: data integrity). get_missed_cleanings counts only a confirmed calendar row, so a blocked row is no longer a missed cleaning or a payable advance (staff_pay_candidates_v1, staff_pay_request_create_v2, staff_pay_admin_create_v2, get_admin_overview_v1 readiness and the missed-cleaning-alert inherit it with no body change). staff_guest_card_v1 appends "YYYY-MM-DD: Turnover report: <text>" to the guest notes for earlier stays whose turnover reported an issue (derived live from cleaning_sessions, nothing stored, staff_redact_v1 still applies); get_guest_timeline_v1 gains a turnover_report event; new internal function turnover_issue_text_v1. run_system_verifier_v1 gains V20 (advance_no_stay, paid_no_link, stuck_paying, session_twice, report_no_stay), V21 (block_named, confirmed_cancelled, daily) and V22 (credit_gone); apply_verifier_run_v1 lists V20/V22 in both scopes and V21 in the daily scope, and an acknowledged RED finding still seen re-opens after 3 days. kpi_tab_v1 (amendment 3, Lloyd 2026-11-11: a sharp one-day spike in the utility chart) redefines only its utility block: readings are ordered by their meter chain, days run between CHECKOUT dates (not report-filing days), a reading that overlaps or leaves a gap in the chain is left out of the per-day figures, months are checkout months, series points gain from/to; V23:meter_chain reports the broken-chain readings. The orchestrator re-stamps restore_point and verified_at on the fresh backup taken before the apply.
backup.notes: Phase backfill is the house label for a function body; no table, column, row or trigger changes. Five function bodies are replaced (each guarded by the md5 of the live body) and one internal helper is added; grants are restated. The data repair for Honey (request 6FF96A06 / BCD28F42) is NOT part of this release: supabase/sql/2026-11-11-s115-honey-6ff96a06.sql, Lloyd's block, after it. Expected live effect after apply: the missed list is Bianca 11-10 only; the dry run of the verifier shows V20:advance_no_stay for 6FF96A06, V20:stuck_paying for BCD28F42, V21:block_named for the cancelled Jasmin row and V22:credit_gone for the paid providers.
